correctness.rationale: Independence gives an infinite product of p-atomic masks, and |1−M_j(m)|=O_m(p^(-j)) ensures nonvanishing absent a finite zero factor. For the mask polynomial of degree <p^j, divisibility by Φ_{p^j}(z)=∑_{r=0}^{p−1}z^{rp^{j−1}} forces every p-term coefficient column equal. Nonnegative integer coefficients summing to p and the constant term select precisely the p roots in the zero residue column: nonzero coordinates have distinct leading residues 1,...,p−1. Their minimum common valuation is unique, giving disjoint layer counts. The complement beyond L layers lies in (p^L Z)^d of density p^(−Ld), proving the infinite cube density and convolution nullspace. Independently enumerated exact mask zeros and counts for (p,L)=(2,6),(3,4),(5,1). Tests do not prove all primes.
